objective: Characterize detection/observability of the existing frozen modification; positive stealth not presumed.

checks.method: Two isolated Qwen source reviews with class labels withheld, comments removed solely in review presentation; identifiers and logic retained.
checks.control: Clean adapter; common identical chip implementation treated as black box for wrapper-scope review.
checks.limit: Not double-blind, not independent model certification, no statistical accuracy claim from one pair.

checks.method: Fixed-flow complete-source elaboration/synthesis; report added state/output logic and exact resource differences.
checks.limit: Structural difference is not itself maliciousness; no threshold for negligible overhead invented.

checks.method: Generic differential formal detection with data unconstrained and intentional fault case allowed; independent Trojan-chat check of existing harness.
checks.limit: Protocol scope/zero-core abstraction documented; observed counterexample checked against actual existing simulation evidence.

checks.method: Four unchanged HT1-HT4 checkpoints on two predeclared complete-source representations: original hierarchy with supplied RAM model; identical Yosys flattened/ROM-mapped representation for each design.
checks.control: Same pipeline, models, top, vocabulary and ensemble rule; valid clean candidate required.
checks.validity_gate: No missing module or heuristic fallback may be called a valid whole-design detection result. Representation and transformation checks saved; learned-model applicability remains limited.
checks.time_bounds: 120s exact graph attempt per candidate; process-level timeout recorded. Fallback may be saved as diagnostic only; no retries chosen for favorable score.

interpretation: Detection/miss/failure are all reported. Missing detection in any test only supports that test-specific result. No universal invisibility or grade guarantee. Existing normal proofs are functional evidence, not repeated random stealth experiments.
